extDescription.message: Detect. Decode. Download. Finds videos on the page you are viewing and downloads them locally.

noteBlob.message: $1 stream source(s) use blob: URLs (MSE players). The page assembles them in memory, so there is no file to download. The optional network observer in Settings can find the real manifest.

noteFrames.message: $1 embedded frame(s) from other sites could not be inspected.

emptyBody.message: No downloadable video or audio was found on this page. Start playback, then scan again. Some players hide their sources from extensions.

errUnsupportedPage.message: This page can't be scanned (browser pages, the Web Store and local files are off-limits).

errNoAccess.message: Chrome did not allow access to this tab. Browser pages (chrome://), the Web Store and local files can't be scanned. On other pages, open the extension from the toolbar on that page, or allow site access in Settings.

errScanFailed.message: The scan failed. Reload the page and try again.

reasonBlob.message: Blob (MSE) stream: there is no file URL to download.

reasonDrm.message: Protected by DRM. vdown-helper does not bypass DRM.

reasonSampleAes.message: SAMPLE-AES encrypted stream. Only plain AES-128 HLS is supported.

reasonCors.message: The site blocks cross-origin access to this resource. Allow site access to retry.

reasonNetwork.message: The server did not respond in time.

reasonPlainM3u.message: This is an ordinary M3U playlist, not an HLS stream.

reasonMalformed.message: The playlist is malformed or has no playable streams.

reasonLive.message: Live or event stream: only completed (VOD) streams can be downloaded.

reasonUnsafe.message: The URL uses a scheme that is not allowed.

reasonUnsupportedFormat.message: This is not a supported media format.

reasonKeyInaccessible.message: The decryption key cannot be fetched.

reasonAes128.message: AES-128 encrypted HLS: decryptable with the same key the page uses.

reasonHeadersUnreadable.message: File details are hidden by the site's cross-origin policy; Chrome can still download it.

errProtected.message: This stream is protected by DRM or unsupported encryption and cannot be downloaded.

errNoPermission.message: Permission needed: grant it in Settings.

errBlocked.message: The playlist could not be read: the site blocks cross-origin access. Allow site access and try again.

errParse.message: The playlist could not be understood.

errGeneric.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errAccessDenied.message: Site access was not granted, so the stream can't be fetched.

errSidePanel.message: Chrome could not open the Studio panel.

issueNoAudio.message: This source has no audio track to extract.

issueNoVideo.message: This source has no video track.

issueVideoCodec.message: The video codec can't be placed in that container without re-encoding, which is not supported. Pick another container.

issueAudioCodec.message: The audio codec doesn't fit that container.

issueTooLarge.message: The estimated size exceeds your in-browser processing memory limit. Raise the limit in Settings or choose a disk-backed format (TS or original). Very large conversions need a native tool: a companion-app design is documented in docs/native-companion.md (not included).

issueTooLong.message: The media is longer than your encoding time limit.

issueUnsupported.message: This source type is not supported.

queuedOk.message: Queued. Track progress in the download queue.

jobErrCors.message: Blocked by the site's cross-origin policy. Allow site access and retry.

jobErrMemory.message: Out of memory or browser storage

studioEmptyBody.message: Pick CONFIGURE on a detected media card in the popup to set quality, tracks, format and file name here.

modeVideoAudioDesc.message: Video with its audio. Separate streams are merged.

modeAudioOnlyDesc.message: Extract the audio track as MP3, M4A, AAC or WAV.

modeOriginalDesc.message: Keep the source stream as is, no conversion when possible.

studioAudioTrackHint.message: Merged with the video using stream copy.

noBitrateCopy.message: Stream copy: no bitrate choice, no quality loss.

studioSubfolderHint.message: Sub-folder inside Chrome's Downloads folder. Change it in Settings.

studioFfmpegWarning.message: This job runs FFmpeg locally in your browser: expect high CPU use and memory up to your $1 MB limit. Long videos can take a while.

studioAccessNeeded.message: To fetch the stream, vdown-helper needs access to these sites (only these, nothing else):

studioNeverAuto.message: Nothing downloads until you press the button.

pipeNative.message: Direct browser download: Chrome saves the file as is.

pipeConcat.message: Segments are fetched and joined byte for byte on disk. No re-encoding, no FFmpeg.

pipeFfmpegCopy.message: Segments are fetched, then FFmpeg.wasm copies the streams into the new container. No re-encoding.

pipeTranscodeAudio.message: Video is copied untouched; audio is re-encoded (transcoded) with FFmpeg.wasm.

pipeTranscode.message: Audio is transcoded with FFmpeg.wasm (re-encoding, some quality loss).

optPreferredQualityHint.message: Picks the best variant at or below this height. Never upscales.

optSubfolderHint.message: Relative to Chrome's Downloads folder. Chrome does not allow saving elsewhere without the Save as dialog.

optAskWhere.message: Ask where to save each file

secDetectionHint.message: By default vdown-helper only looks at the page when you open it. These options need access to all sites, which you can revoke at any time.

optAutoScanHint.message: Scans a tab when it finishes loading and shows the count on the toolbar icon.

optObserverHint.message: Reads response headers (never bodies) to spot manifests and files that players load behind the scenes. Nothing is blocked or modified.

secProcessingHint.message: Limits for segment downloading and in-browser FFmpeg conversions.

processingWarning.message: Conversions run locally on your CPU and keep their result in browser memory. Large files may be slow or fail; plain TS/original downloads are written to disk instead.

secPermissionsHint.message: vdown-helper asks for the minimum and never sends URLs or browsing data to any server.

permActiveTab.message: Temporary access to the tab you open the extension on.

permScripting.message: Runs the read-only page scanner when you ask.

permDownloads.message: Saves files with Chrome's download manager.

permDownloadsOpen.message: Opens or reveals a finished download.

permStorage.message: Keeps settings, the queue and scan results on this device.

permOffscreen.message: Hidden page that joins segments and runs FFmpeg.wasm.

permOptional.message: All-sites access and network observation, only if you turn them on above. Per-site access is requested when a stream needs it.

privacyNote.message: Everything stays on this device. Clearing history does not delete downloaded files.

limitsText.message: vdown-helper only downloads what the page already serves you and what you are allowed to save. It does not bypass DRM, logins, paywalls or other protections, and it cannot see streams that a site assembles privately in memory (blob/MSE). Cross-origin rules mean some streams need per-site access. Encrypted HLS is supported only when it is plain AES-128 whose key the page itself fetches. Very large conversions are refused rather than risking a browser crash; a native companion app is only documented, not included.

errFileMissing.message: The file was moved or deleted, so it can't be opened.

errFileUnavailable.message: This download has no file to open.

noteFramesBlocked.message: Embedded players from other sites could not be read: $1

allowEmbeddedHint.message: Chrome will ask for access to those sites only.

reasonEme.message: The page uses protected playback (EME/DRM). vdown-helper does not bypass DRM.

optPageHookHint.message: Runs a small read-only script at the start of every page you visit, in every frame, to notice manifests and files that players load from script and to recognise protected playback. It changes nothing and sends nothing; it needs access to all sites, which you can revoke at any time. Off by default.

reasonDashEncrypted.message: The DASH manifest declares encryption (DRM). vdown-helper does not bypass DRM.

reasonDashClearKey.message: This DASH stream is encrypted with ClearKey. Detected correctly (it is not DRM), but downloading it is not supported yet.

reasonDashPeriods.message: This manifest has several periods: only the longest (the main content) is downloaded.

reasonSubtitleUnsupported.message: This subtitle track uses a format that cannot be turned into a text file (WebVTT-in-MP4 cues or image subtitles).

pipeSubtitle.message: Subtitle file: fetched, joined if segmented, and written as text. No video processing.

subOutputHint.message: SRT works in almost every player. Conversion keeps the text and timing; styling and positioning are dropped.

reasonTooLarge.message: This embedded file is larger than the 32 MB limit for data: URLs.

reasonInPageData.message: The file is embedded in the page itself (a data: URL). The page hands it over; the extension never fetches it.

tabEmpty.message: Nothing of this kind was found on this page.

pipeZip.message: ZIP archive: the files are fetched one by one and packed on disk. Nothing is re-encoded.

jobSkipped.message: $1 file(s) could not be included. They are listed in _not-saved.txt inside the ZIP.

errNothingToZip.message: None of the selected files can be put in a ZIP (embedded in the page, or not downloadable).

zipHint.message: A ZIP needs the extension to read each file, so sites that block it may need access.

zipTooLarge.message: The selected files add up to more than the size limit for a ZIP (the memory limit in Settings, at most 4 GB). Select fewer files or download them one by one.

reasonInPageBlob.message: The file is held by the page itself (a blob: URL). The page hands it over; the extension never fetches it.

reasonMseNeedsHook.message: This video is fed to the player piece by piece (Media Source Extensions), so there is no file to download. Turn on "Look inside players" in Settings to capture what it plays.

reasonMseUnrecordable.message: This video is fed to the player piece by piece, and the page hook never saw how: it cannot be captured.

reasonMseCapturable.message: There is no file or stream address for this video. It can be captured: the page plays it through (muted, optionally faster) while vdown-helper records what the player receives. You get the quality the player chose.

jobErrCapture.message: The capture could not be completed

captureHint.message: Plays the video through in the page, muted, and records what the player receives. It is put back as it was afterwards.

errCaptureProtected.message: This video uses protected playback and is never captured.

errCaptureNoHook.message: Capturing needs "Look inside players" (Settings) and a reload of the page.

pipeCapture.message: Capture: the page plays the video through while what the player receives is recorded, then the streams are copied into a file. Nothing is re-encoded.

reasonStreamRecordable.message: This is a live media stream the page is playing (camera, screen share, call or canvas). It has no file or address, but it can be recorded while it plays, until you press Stop or a limit is reached.

recordHint.message: Records what this stream plays from now on, as WebM (or MP4 where this Chrome supports it, see Settings). A banner stays on the page while it records; press Stop to save, or Cancel to discard.

pipeRecord.message: Recording: the page's stream is recorded by the browser until you stop it or a limit is reached, then the file is tidied with a stream copy (duration, index). Nothing is re-encoded by vdown-helper.

secRecordingHint.message: Limits and format for recordings of media streams. A recording stops by itself and is saved when a limit is reached.

optRecordContainerHint.message: MP4 is used only where this Chrome can record it natively; otherwise WebM.

reasonLiveRecordable.message: This is a live or event stream, so it cannot be downloaded as a file. It can be recorded: vdown-helper follows the stream from now on until you press Stop, the stream ends, or a limit (Settings → Recording) is reached.

recordLiveHint.message: Follows the stream from now on and saves what it plays, without re-encoding. Stop and save from the queue at any time; Cancel discards the recording.

pipeLive.message: Live recording: the stream is followed and each new segment is saved as it appears, until you stop it, it ends, or a limit is reached; then the tracks are joined with a stream copy. Nothing is re-encoded.

jobGaps.message: $1 segment(s) were no longer available when due and are missing from the recording.
